guard_streams.source: January 2026 OMR and premises in BDUK plans (England and Wales)

facts.detail: BDUK published the January 2026 OMR and premises-in-plans release on 4 June 2026.
The publication applies to England and Wales and links separate publications for Scotland and Northern Ireland.
The release provides a sample CSV and region-level ZIP files for the January 2026 data.
The release describes BDUK's premises-level view of OMR determinations, current connectivity, future commercial plans and BDUK interventions.
The publication includes a UPRN-level user guide and technical note for technical users.

guard_streams.source: Open Market Review (OMR) determinations and BDUK plans

facts.detail: The OMR determinations and BDUK plans collection was first published on 1 July 2025.
The collection was last updated on 4 June 2026.
The collection groups premises-level OMR determinations and BDUK plan publications.
The collection lists January 2026, September 2025, May 2025 and January 2025 OMR releases plus March 2025 premises-in-plans data.
The update history records that the January 2026 OMR document was added on 4 June 2026.

guard_streams.source: UPRN level release user guide and technical note for premises in BDUK plans

facts.detail: The January 2026 UPRN-level user guide and technical note was published on 4 June 2026.
Region and local-authority fields use updated NSUL December 2025, NSPL November 2025 and ONSUD November 2025 data.
The release is optimised for technical users and programming software; spreadsheet software may not display every row.
BDUK plans updated releases alongside the latest OMR closure notice, approximately once every four months.
The premises base uses AddressBase Premium and is filtered to remove non-postal and demolished premises.

guard_streams.source: June 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts

facts.detail: BDUK publishes the June page as monthly contract-level Project Gigabit progress data.
Contracted-premises figures cover the initial scope of contracts and may exclude deferred scope.
The management-information figures are not directly comparable with BDUK official statistics.
The table is a snapshot of data held by BDUK on 17 June 2026.
Variable ingestion lag means the table should not be used to assess whether contractual milestones were met.
